blocks.p: Legendary Survivor in about 4 hours, or 534 skill points a day. Normal mode, {mission:527}; about 8 minutes to set up, then it runs indefinitely.

blocks.note: The original guide is still on the {ext:https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/User:Foo/GoM|Guild Wars Wiki} ({ext:https://web.archive.org/web/2026/https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/User:Foo/GoM|archived copy}).

img.caption: The farm running: bonders at the end of the long shadow (flag 3), the player just south of the Portal Wraiths, the Keystone on the far edge of the aggro bubble (flag 1).

ul: A Chaos Rift spawns 8 Titans every 30 seconds, and {why:you tank them|About 3 damage packets a second, around the clock.}.

Under {skill:263} and the Lightbringer title, your health is set so {why:each packet does only 1 damage|Protective Bond caps a hit at a twentieth of your maximum health, rounded down, and each Lightbringer rank takes 1 more off a Titan's hit. Between LB×20+20 and LB×20+39 health that leaves exactly 1: at LB4, 100 to 119.}.

Two Monk heroes {why:keep the bonds up|Your health balance: the 1-damage hits, bleeding and burning, against the bonds' health regeneration (Mending, Succor, Watchful Spirit) and Purifying Veil's shorter conditions.}; through {skill:250}, {why:that 1 damage pays their energy back|The energy balance: Protective Bond costs its caster energy on every packet it cuts; Essence Bond returns energy on physical and elemental packets (not holy ones), Balthazar's Spirit, Blessed Signet and Succor the rest. At 0 damage nothing comes back.}.
A {skill:63} Mesmer hero kills. The rest of the party stays away, so the XP is split only two ways.

builds.name: Player
builds.note: Any profession. 5 Leadership from an "of the Paragon" mod; health by LB rank (table below).

builds.name: Prot Bonder
builds.note: {why:Bonds first|The order matters for what Protective Bond costs: with the higher Protection cast first (18, then 13) each bonder pays 1 energy a packet; cast the other way round, one of them pays more.}. 16 Protection (18 after Heroic Refrain), 7 Divine Favor.

builds.name: Heal Bonder
builds.note: Bonds second. 16 Healing (18 after Heroic Refrain), 11 Protection (13 after Heroic Refrain), 7 Divine Favor.

builds.name: Keystone
builds.note: 16 Fast Casting, 15 Inspiration with runes. {why:No weapon|The hero must cast, not attack: with a weapon the AI wands between signets. In our runs a wand cost 4% of its casts and a Titan lived a second longer. No shield either: the Keystone should not look like a target.}.

box.title: Optional: without Heroic Refrain (LB4 and up)

blocks.p: As an alternative {why:at LB4 and up|Not at LB2 or LB3: without Heroic Refrain's +2 the bonds heal less and conditions last longer, and at those ranks the margins are already thin.}, you can be the third bonder instead of using Heroic Refrain. Two bonders need 18 and 13 Protection, but three can do with 13, 8 and 3: the Prot Bonder at 13, the Heal Bonder at 8 and you at 3, bonding in that order.

builds.name: Player
builds.note: Monk secondary with 3 Protection. {why:Your Protective Bond goes on last|The lowest Protection casts last: 13, 8, then your 3, and each of the three pays 1 energy a packet.}, and Balthazar's Spirit fully pays for your share of it.

blocks.p: The cost: without Heroic Refrain's +2, Purifying Veil and Mending are weaker, so conditions last longer and Mending gives less health regeneration. That's a little less safe at high LB, and still fine at LB4.

ul: Party order: the 3 heroes in the first three slots, {why:so each has its own flag|Alternatively they can sit anywhere in the party if you bind keys to flag heroes one by one: Options, Control, Command Hero 1 to 7.}.

Bonders: {why:all bonds disabled|So the heroes don't recast or drop them: you trigger each bond yourself, in order.}, {why:about 50 energy|The pool matters less than the balance: at 3 damage packets a second Protective Bond drains 9 pips of energy for every energy point it charges its caster, and the bonders earn it back from Essence Bond (about 6 pips), Balthazar's Spirit (9), Succor (1) and Blessed Signet (three quarters of a pip per enchantment). 50 covers the swings.}.

blocks.p: Wear a low-armor set (from Banoit, Kambei, Moon Ahn, Nu Leng or Mehinu), with health by LB rank:

3: "of the Necromancer" weapons on both bonders: 5 Soul Reaping, energy every time a Titan dies.
2: "of the Necromancer" weapons on both bonders: 5 Soul Reaping, energy every time a Titan dies.
A +1/20% Protection item on the Prot Bonder, Purifying Veil recast until it lands at 62%.

notes: ¹ The other ways, on hover, are for a character short of runes or insignia. A value marked (2 damage) is the best that rank gets without going under 80 health: hits do {why:2 damage|Below the window a hit does 0 and the bonders get no energy; above it, 2 just makes them work harder. So err on the high side, and never under 80 health.}, which is safer than less health.

blocks.p: Required at LB3 and below, optional above.
"of the Necromancer" weapons on both bonders: 5 Soul Reaping, energy every time a Titan dies.

A +1/20% Protection item on the Prot Bonder, Purifying Veil recast until it lands at {why:62%|Veil makes conditions expire 5% faster plus 3% per Protection rank, with the seconds rounded up: at 18 Protection (59%) the Titans' 5-second Burning lasts 3 seconds, at 19 (62%) 2. The +1 lands one cast in five: cancel the Veil and recast until it shows 62%.}, which cuts Burning to 2 seconds.

Fight your way to the Chaos Rifts, east of the Temple of the Six Gods, {why:the way the white line on the map comes in|Down from the north, east along the wall, round the pocket where the other heroes will stand, and down to the Torment rift.}.

ul: The 3 Portal Wraiths at the {why:Torment rift|Marked "clear it" on the map, where the white arrow ends.}: +2% morale.
The 3 Torment creatures and 2 Margonites patrolling.
The 2 Titan Abominations patrolling the area: killed ones respawn.
The 3 Portal Wraiths at the {why:Titan rift|The one you farm: just north of you on the map.}: all three dead, no more Titans, run over.

{why:Everything further west|The Portal Wraiths at the three rifts marked "leave alone" on the map, and the patrols around them.}: none of it interferes with the farm, and closing another rift would add morale and throw off your health.

ol: Flag the bonders {why:and the Keystone|For now: step 5 flags it to its final place, at the edge of your aggro bubble.} {why:at the tip of the long shadow|The Bonders spot on the map.}; flag everyone else {why:out of compass range|So they can't join in: no heals, no attacks, no aggro, nothing to upset the balance. The bonders stay within compass range, which the bonds need to hold.}.

ol.t: Wield the "of the Paragon" weapon. Then one bonder at a time: cast HR on it, then its 4 bonds on you:
sub: Prot Bonder: Protective Bond and Purifying Veil while HR is on it, then Succor and Essence Bond.
Heal Bonder: Protective Bond and Mending while HR is on it, then Watchful Spirit and Essence Bond.

ol: Switch to the low-health set, check your health, then {why:reactivate the Lightbringer title|Damage reductions apply in the order their effects went on you. Bond first, then title: the bond caps the packet, the title subtracts its rank from what's left, 1 remains.}.
Aggro the Titans and stand {why:just south of the Portal Wraiths|The You spot on the map, south of the Titan rift.}, without aggroing them.
Flag the Keystone to {why:the edge of your aggro bubble|The Keystone spot on the map, on the edge of your aggro bubble, marked yellow.}, away from the Wraiths, and use the scroll.

blocks.p: Before going AFK, watch two or three Titan waves: the Madness Titans bleed and burn you, and their holy damage pays no Essence Bond energy. If your health holds and the bonders' energy doesn't drop, you're set.

From here the farm runs itself: 8 Titans every 30 seconds, 348 XP each, about 334,000 XP an hour. That is Legendary Survivor in about 4 hours, and about 22 skill points an hour for as long as you leave it running.

img.caption: About 3,000 hours of it, Legendary Survivor a distant memory.
